LESSON: UNITY OF MUSLIMS

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Islamic Heritage and Civilisation
Topic 7.2: Unity of Muslims
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Unity of Muslims, part of Islamic Heritage and Civilisation in Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is the unity of Muslims important? 2. What hinders the unity of Muslims?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. research online/read from available reference materials on the factors that enhance the unity of Muslims in Kenya and make class presentations,

2. describe the challenges that undermine the unity of Muslims in groups and make notes,

3. listen to a talk from a resource person on the significance of the unity of Muslims and make notes,

4. dramatise acts that foster unity among Muslims. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. research online/read from available reference materials on the factors that enhance the unity of Muslims in Kenya and make class presentations,
2. describe the challenges that undermine the unity of Muslims in groups and make notes,
3. listen to a talk from a resource person on the significance of the unity of Muslims and make notes,
4. dramatise acts that foster unity among Muslims. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Unity of Muslims together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-efficacy: the skill of effective communication enhanced as learners discuss the challenges that undermine

the unity of Muslims in groups.

• Citizenship: the skill of national and cultural identity enhanced as learners research online/read on the factors

that enhance the unity of Muslims.

• Creativity and Imagination: the skill of networking is enhanced as learners dramatise acts that foster unity

among Muslims.

43

Values:
• Unity is enhanced as learners dramatise acts that foster unity among Muslims.

• Responsibility is enhanced as learners listen to a talk from a resource person on the significance of unity of Muslims and

make notes.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
• Social Cohesion as learners research online on the factors that enhance the unity of Muslims.

• Patriotism as learners dramatise acts that foster unity among Muslims.

Link to other Subjects:
